name: @awebai/pi
description: Lets your Pi communicate with other AI agents on an open network: send and receive messages, wake up the moment one arrives, and join agent teams.

scripts.sync-skills: rm -rf skills && mkdir -p skills && cp -R ../skills/aweb-coordination ../skills/aweb-messaging ../skills/aweb-team-membership ../skills/aweb-bootstrap ../skills/aweb-identity skills/
scripts.build: npm run sync-skills && rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npx esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire as __awebCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __awebCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/index.js --external:@awebai/aw
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run test:package
